identity: Machine Spirit / original kit symbol and Reference 2 wordmark
themePersistence: New sessions start light; explicit dark-mode choices last within the current tab session
interfaceIcons: Custom Morphicons on a 24px grid, rendered at 20px with 1.5 strokes, square terminals, chamfered outlines and damped hover motion
light: Original ink symbol and Reference 2 lettering on pale stone static, with a subtle contact shadow
dark: Original ivory symbol and white Reference 2 lettering on deep charcoal static, with a soft dark shadow
wordmark: Original brand-kit three-row, seven-piece symbol and exact Reference 2 image lettering; no relief recoloring or flattened artwork
readingSurface: Fog is the approved light mode: a luminous centre over a pale grey-green field, solid graphite text and visible machine static
lightContrast: Fog reading colours retain at least 7.08:1 primary and 4.69:1 secondary contrast against the conservative darkest combined static, gradient, atmospheric shade and hover values. No reading text uses outlines or text shadows
hero: Raw Transmission retains its dark cinematic palette in both UI themes
smallUse: White Soft Relief favicon on light stone; silhouette-weighted optical centering and size-specific graphite edges keep the three rows clear. Search fallback remains flat

typography.heading: Orbitron for section headings; Source Sans 3 for names and compact card titles

noise: Visible two-scale seeded static retains the original stepped movement; a low-contrast atmospheric field drifts on a 56-second cycle beneath it. Text stays still and reduced-motion preferences stop both animations

brandKitVerification.ivorySymbol: Identical viewBox, transforms and all seven vector paths to 04 Logo Masters/flat-symbol.svg; existing ivory tint retained
